MBO+/HBO level of working and thinking At least 1 year of experience as a Supervisor, or several years of experience as an Assistant Supervisor with leadership responsibility Experience in a logistics or warehouse environment Experience working with complex systems, such as SAP, ERP, or WMS Good command of the English language Willingness to work in a two-shift schedule An analytical and results-oriented approach to work A coaching and collaborative leadership style Wat bieden wij je? You will work in a professional and international environment where automation, development, and continuous process improvement are at the heart of the operation. Your own professional development is also given plenty of attention. At the Lelystad location, a modern warehouse environment is being developed, with automation and technology playing a key role. The site is part of a larger international organization with thousands of employees and locations worldwide. Within this new operation, logistics, data, and automated processes come together. This makes it an exciting environment for a Supervisor who likes to look beyond the day-to-day planning. You will also have the opportunity to help build the operation from the ground up. Together with your colleagues, you will develop efficient ways of working, build strong teams, and create a warehouse operation that is ready for further growth.

Are you an experienced Order Picker looking for a new challenge in logistics? Then we have a great opportunity for you.

As an Order Picker, you are responsible for collecting and processing orders using a hand scanner. You will operate an EPT daily and ensure that orders are picked accurately, completed on time, and prepared for shipment. In addition, you will check incoming and outgoing goods and help keep warehouse locations organised and efficient.

You will work with a modern warehouse management system where logistics processes are accurately recorded. Thanks to your attention to detail, orders are processed correctly and inventory data remains up to date. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that daily warehouse operations run smoothly and customers receive their orders on time.

You will work in different warehouse zones, including chilled areas and freezer sections with temperatures of up to -15°C. You are comfortable working in a temperature-controlled environment where quality, speed, and food safety are essential. Professional protective clothing will be provided to ensure you can work safely and comfortably.

Working hours take place between 07:00 and 00:00. You will join a dedicated team where teamwork, reliability, and a positive attitude are highly valued. Your contribution plays an important role in keeping the logistics operation running efficiently.
